item.title: Make My Photo Look Professional

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.

item.tests: Uses reasonable defaults for a vague professional portrait request without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.

dialog.agent: What should change in the picture?

turns.agent:
Your Magic Hour account doesn’t have enough credits for this edit, so no image was created.

Once you add credits, I can give it a professional headshot look with a navy blazer, a neutral background, and softer lighting while preserving your natural features.

style.prompt: Edit this portrait into a realistic professional business headshot of the same man. Preserve his identity, facial structure, age, short gray hair, natural facial features and realistic skin texture. Replace the gray T-shirt with a well-tailored navy blazer over a crisp light blue collared shirt. Replace the kitchen background with a simple neutral light gray studio background. Use flattering soft professional portrait lighting, balanced exposure and natural colors. Keep his direct eye contact and composed approachable expression. Head-and-shoulders square composition. No text. Avoid excessive skin smoothing or changing his appearance.
